test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven students H, I, J, K, L, M and N have all scored unique number of marks. H scored only more than N. Marks of three students were between the marks of J and I. I did not score the highest marks. How many students scored less than J?
solution:
As per the given information,

1) H scored only more than N.

_ > _ > _ > _ > _ > H > N

2) Marks of three students were between the marks of J and I.

3) I did not score the highest marks.

J > _ > _ > _ > I > H > N

Clearly, 6 students scored less than J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**.
